kamloops.title: Hamburgers, water and support waiting for B.C. fire evacuees
kamloops.description: With thousands forced from their homes due to fires around Okanagan Lake, the Salvation Army in Vernon has become a place for people to gather as they figure out what's next.

kamloops.title: Okanagan wildfires force more evacuation orders as First Nation assesses losses
kamloops.description: Further up the lake, the Regional District of North Okanagan expanded evacuation orders and alerts on Sunday for dozens of properties because of the Bradley Creek wildfire.

all.title: B.C. wildfires grow, put more than 5K under evacuation orders in past 24 hours
all.description: There are now approximately 130 wildfires burning in British Columbia, with BC Wildfire Service reporting almost half of those are considered out-of-control.

all.title: Recipe: Summer soba noodle salad
all.description: If the heat is getting to you and you need a simple, but tasty, summer recipe, this summer noodle soba salad is sure to hit the right spot.

all.title: B.C. wildfires destroy lakeside homes, with 30 new added in past 24 hours
all.description: Even if a wildfire is not threatening your community, the BC Wildfire Service is recommending that British Columbians be prepared if you need to leave quickly.

all.title: Possible WestJet strike has Kelowna travellers worried about their plans
all.description: WestJet has also begun preparing for a possible disruption by grounding some aircraft to avoid stranding additional passengers and planes.
